nodes.label: United States
nodes.description: Major military power currently engaged in a war with Iran alongside Israel, also dealing with domestic events.

nodes.label: Iran
nodes.description: Country under US-Israeli bombing campaign, experiencing civilian sheltering and wartime conditions.

nodes.label: Israel
nodes.description: Country allied with the US in the war against Iran, also facing criticism over West Bank settler violence.

nodes.label: Russia
nodes.description: Country seeking diplomatic and economic gains from the Iran war, also targeted by Ukrainian strikes.

nodes.label: Ukraine
nodes.description: Country that struck a Russian missile component plant, continuing its war against Russia.

nodes.label: United Kingdom
nodes.description: Accused by Russia of helping Ukraine strike, and demanding Israel stop settler violence in West Bank.

nodes.label: France
nodes.description: A French aid worker was killed in drone strikes in DR Congo.

nodes.label: Australia
nodes.description: Country that granted asylum to an Iranian football delegation member; also involved in trademark case.

nodes.label: Canada
nodes.description: Country where PM Mark Carney's Liberals are inching closer to a majority government.

nodes.label: Norway
nodes.description: Country where an explosion occurred at the US embassy in Oslo, with potential foreign state actor involvement.

nodes.label: European Union
nodes.description: Demanding Israel stop the surge in West Bank settler violence since the Iran war began.

nodes.label: G7
nodes.description: Group of nations that agreed to a record release of emergency oil reserves in response to price surges.

nodes.label: Donald Trump
nodes.description: US President who called for an Iran uprising, drawing comparisons to Iraq 1991.

nodes.label: Vladimir Putin
nodes.description: Russian President positioning himself as potential mediator in the Iran war while seeking gains.

nodes.label: Mark Carney
nodes.description: Canadian Prime Minister whose Liberal Party is inching closer to a parliamentary majority.

nodes.label: US-Israel-Iran War
nodes.description: Ongoing military conflict where the US and Israel are conducting a bombing campaign against Iran, causing global repercussions.

nodes.label: Oil Price Surge
nodes.description: Surge in global oil prices caused by the US-Israel war with Iran.

nodes.label: Emergency Oil Reserve Release
nodes.description: Record release of emergency oil reserves by G7 nations to counter price surges.

nodes.label: West Bank Settler Violence
nodes.description: Surge in Israeli settler attacks in the West Bank since the Iran war began, killing six Palestinians.

nodes.label: Oslo US Embassy Explosion
nodes.description: Explosion at the US embassy in Oslo, Norway; three brothers arrested, foreign state actor investigated.

nodes.label: Ukraine Strike on Russian Plant
nodes.description: Ukraine hit a Russian missile component manufacturing plant.

nodes.label: DR Congo Drone Strikes
nodes.description: Drone strikes hit a residential building in Goma, killing a French aid worker and two others.

nodes.label: Iranian Football Delegation Asylum
nodes.description: Members of an Iranian football delegation sought and received asylum in Australia.

nodes.label: Trump's Iran Uprising Call
nodes.description: Trump called for an uprising in Iran, drawing parallels to the 1991 Iraq situation.

nodes.label: Iraq 1991 Uprising
nodes.description: Historical event where an uprising in Iraq after the Gulf War serves as a cautionary lesson.

nodes.label: Lori Idlout
nodes.description: Former NDP MP who defected to the Liberal Party in Canada.

nodes.label: Liberal Party of Canada
nodes.description: Canadian governing party under Mark Carney, gaining defectors and approaching a majority.

nodes.label: United Nations
nodes.description: Reports six Palestinians killed during settler attacks in the West Bank.
